excerpts.author: krisoshea.eth
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, here is my week five update. This week we mainly focused on creating and finalizing the project presentation for the Lodestar Builder.

We then moved into setting up our workspace in terms of how we're going to work and collab across the next 16 weeks. That involved things like forking the lodestar repo, setting up Linear, our code review tools, and then our collaboration communication tools that we'll be using going forward.

We also created our planning document and are thinking about how we're going to work with the Lodestar repo and the Lodestar team, as well as how we're going to translate all of our plans into the relevant issues and divide up the work between us. I hope you enjoy the write-up. Thanks.

Key takeaways is several internal drafts and iterations on it with Vansh, much better understand of 8304 purpose and details of implementation. After a brief research testing with Kurtosis is much more clear and the whole proposals seems to be pretty-much doable. Vansh would probably keep focusing on Geth and getting the PoC ready. And in the meantime I'd take care of Viem's experimental support for 8304 and e2e tests suite

Here is my week 5 update. 

This week I wrapped up the scoped work on the REST-SSZ engine API for Lighthouse mentioned in my [week 3&4 update](https://hackmd.io/@samag19/Sk5HOI6Qfl#Changes-scoped-out-for-now), opened both a draft PR on Lighthouse for the same and created the project proposal for it whose PR is still in review. 

I also picked up a second project, the Grandine Lean Client, after Sagar brought me on, I got my local Hive test setup running, dug into the codebase and started exploring. 

Next up: gearing up for my proposal presentation on `REST-SSZ engine API for Lighthouse` scheduled on Wednesday
